hooks.text: A single tunnel on the Moon is wide enough to hold Philadelphia.
You could fit an entire city inside a hidden lunar cave.
The Moon's surface is a trap, but its interior is a sanctuary.

title: The Massive Tunnels Hidden Beneath the Moon
description: Beneath the Moon's surface lie gargantuan lava tubes large enough to house entire cities. New radar data confirms these ancient conduits are ready for human exploration.

beats.text: A single tunnel on the Moon is wide enough to hold Philadelphia.
beats.visual: artist's concept of an underground lunar base, 2022

beats.text: Most people see the Moon as a solid, cratered rock baked by radiation.
beats.visual: LRO image of the lunar surface showing craters, 2015

beats.text: But in 2009, the Japanese Kaguya spacecraft spotted a massive dark pit in the Marius Hills.
beats.visual: artist's concept of the JAXA Kaguya SELENE orbiter, 2007

beats.text: This skylight is actually a collapsed roof over an ancient lava tube.
beats.visual: LRO photograph of the Marius Hills Pit skylight, 2011

beats.text: These tunnels formed billions of years ago when molten rivers cooled and drained away.
beats.visual: illustration showing the formation of a volcanic lava tube, 2018

beats.text: On Earth, lava tubes are cramped, but the Moon's low gravity allows them to reach impossible sizes.
beats.visual: diagram comparing gravity on Earth and the Moon, 2020

beats.text: Theoretical models show these rock cathedrals can stay stable at widths of five kilometers.
beats.visual: artist's concept of a city inside a lunar lava tube, 2023

beats.text: In 2024, radar confirmed an accessible cave conduit beneath the Sea of Tranquility.
beats.visual: radar map of the Mare Tranquillitatis cave conduit, 2024

beats.text: Future colonists will find safety inside a tunnel on the Moon wide enough to hold Philadelphia.
beats.visual: interior view of a modular lunar habitat, 2021

better_than_last: Applies the myth_vs_fact pattern from ep165 to overturn the belief of a solid Moon with concrete scale, while swapping 'black hole' for 'dark pit' per reviewer feedback.
